column1: # Sweep the cardinality penalty at a 2-violation (d=2).

# Default card_exp=20 -> exp=3 (cubic) -> weight at d=2 is 2^3 = 8.
# Each config sets card_exp so 2^exp ~= the target 2-violation value below.
